'''Hosk''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the planet [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]]. The moon saw a period of industrialization when [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]] was built across its surface. It was destroyed in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TNEC" />
